title: From Mughal Court to Colonial Rule
goal: Read and discuss an original text on the Mughal Empire's rise and its transition to British colonial rule, independently running the reciprocal-teaching routine, reviewing cause/effect and sequence structure, and completing a comprehensive syntax review (all 4 foci, one sentence each).
newToday: No new strategy or structure — comprehensive syntax review is this lesson's distinct feature.
review: Cause/effect structure, sequence structure, all 6 strategies, reciprocal teaching (independent), long-sentence chunking, pronoun reference tracing, connectives, passive voice — all four, one real sentence each from today's text.
